openai.reasoning: Le répondant discute le dilemme en termes de rationalité/majorité et finit par défendre le bouton bleu comme maximisant les chances de survie, sans reconnaître que le rouge est individuellement dominant (et sans erreur mécanique explicite).

gemini.reasoning: The respondent consistently avoids making a personal choice, framing the dilemma as a complex philosophical problem rather than committing to a button. They demonstrate a clear rule error in Q2 by suggesting that red-pressers might not survive if the majority chooses red ('this argument ignores the possibility that this choice could...'), and they fail to identify the dominance of the red button, instead treating the choice as a matter of social or philosophical preference.
